player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} playing a game of Checkers as {color}.
Make your move in chess-style notation [fileRank fileRank], e.g. '[b2c3]' (column letter a–h, row digit 0–7).
Basic rules:
  • Move diagonally forward by 1 if empty.
  • Capture by jumping over an opponent piece.
  • A piece is Kinged if it reaches the opposite end.

game_action.moved: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {player_id} acï lɔ tueŋ {move}.

outcome.red_no_pieces: Aciŋ thith acïn kä ye kek mat. Raan col ee tɔŋ tiam!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Aciɛr acï këde ye thɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ jal nyaai. Athör de kɔc ɣer acë bɛ̈n tiaam!
outcome.no_moves: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {player_id} acïn kë cï döŋ bï looi.
outcome.draw: Kä ye kek waar yiic acï bɛ̈n thök.
